div.div:
Target differences
LocalCluster = four Linux Mint PCs on a LAN.
Cloud = four Hetzner servers (type from server_type); only cloud-main has public networking and is the SSH bastion; private nodes use its NAT; Hetzner and host firewalls.

div.div:
Notation
3D box = node («device» or «execution environment»); dashed = «external»
page with corner = «artifact»; nesting = allocated-to
thick line = protocol link (label = protocol); arrow = one-way telemetry
dashed frame opt [ ] = deployed only when observability is enabled
